title: Coincident

inlines.v: COINCIDENT, adjective 1. Falling on the same point; meeting as lines, surfaces or bodies; followed by with. 2. Concurrent; consistent; agreeable to; followed by with. Christianity teaches nothing but what is perfectly coincident with the ruling principles of a virtuous man.
